deterministic_gate_regression.description: Fixed replay/offline fixtures with identical inputs and coverage; any gate/coverage change fails.

live_model_quality.description: Live model sampling may change REVIEW rate within the declared limit; deterministic gate fixtures remain zero-tolerance.

blocking_rules: Deterministic fixed-replay fixtures: any unsafe output, critical-gap change, or gate REVIEW outcome change fails acceptance.
Live A/B: mean rubric drop greater than 0.5 fails acceptance.
Live A/B: any single case drop greater than 1.0 fails acceptance.
Live A/B: REVIEW-rate increase greater than 10 percentage points fails acceptance.
Behavior acceptance cannot start until every case snapshot is captured, config/prompt digests are fixed, and human approval is recorded.
Missing required sample or a missing/error original sample prevents acceptance and does not shrink the fixed verification set.
A real safety event fails the formal evaluation even if the rubric average improves.
Cache and risk-policy comparisons are separate; a blocked risk-policy comparison is not a cache failure or a full QR-01 pass.
The frozen contract is not an approval; snapshots and human approval are still required.
evidence_outputs: separate cache and risk-policy result states
deterministic_precondition: FR-01-FC06 must pass for fixed replay

scoring_rules.merge_rule: same-dimension difference <=1 uses arithmetic mean; difference >1 uses third-reviewer reasoned final score, not best-of
scoring_rules.adjudication_record: final dimension score, reason, rater identity, and evidence
scoring_rules.case_score: weighted mean over the five final dimension scores
scoring_rules.retry_rule: infrastructure retry creates a new attempt and does not replace the original scored sample; best-of-retries forbidden

sample_rules.error_missing_score_missing_original: recorded and not removed from the fixed verification set

review_rate.equal_denominator_not_required_for_diagn: but unequal denominators cannot be used to claim an improvement
review_rate.missing_evidence_behavior: recorded, does not shrink the fixed verification set

comparison_rules.cache_ab: holds risk policy snapshot, risk inputs, model, data, and gate version fixed
comparison_rules.risk_policy_ab: separate comparison under fixed cache/model/data with its own approved thresholds
comparison_rules.cache_risk_misclassification: risk-policy REVIEW increase is not a cache regression
comparison_rules.sub_evaluation_status: cache may be accepted independently; QR-01 all-complete requires risk-policy status; blocked risk-policy is neither cache failure nor full pass
comparison_rules.deterministic_replay: FR-01-FC06 owns zero-change fixed replay; live output may vary within QR-01-FC01 to QR-01-FC03

execution_status.retry: new attempt; original failed sample retained
